test_title: PYST 67: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The value of a machine in a company depreciates by 10% every year. Determine the value (in Rs.) of the machine after 2 years if the current value is Rs. 2 lakh.
solution:
**Given:**

Initial value = Rs. 2 lakh

Annual depreciation = 10%

**Concept:**

Use the formula for annual depreciation, which is Value after n years = Initial value × (1 - Depreciation rate)ⁿ.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Value after 2 years = 2 lakh × (1 - 10/100)² = Rs. 1,62,000 lakh

**Hence, the value of the machine after 2 years is Rs. 1,62,000 lakh.**
